settings.cli_path.label: Wordspring CLI
settings.cli_path.description: Executable name on PATH or a path to wordspring-lookup. Paths beginning with ~/ are supported.
settings.config_path.label: Shared settings file
settings.config_path.description: Leave blank to share wordspringrc with KRunner in the XDG configuration directory.
settings.dictionaries_json.label: Dictionary override (JSON)
settings.dictionaries_json.description: Optional ordered source/name/enabled/label objects. Blank uses shared dictionary settings. Manage shared sources in the panel's Dictionaries view.
settings.krunner_keyword.label: KRunner keyword
settings.krunner_keyword.description: Blank keeps the shared setting. Use Apply shared settings in the panel to save a new keyword. Noctalia's launcher prefix is configured in its launcher settings.
settings.python_executable.label: Import Python
settings.python_executable.description: Blank uses Wordspring's shared interpreter. Apple import needs PyGlossary in that interpreter. Apply shared settings in the panel to save it for KRunner too.
settings.limit_per_dictionary.label: Results per dictionary
settings.timeout_ms.label: Lookup timeout (milliseconds)
settings.panel_debounce_ms.label: Panel search delay (milliseconds)
settings.glyph.label: Bar glyph
settings.show_label.label: Show Wordspring text in horizontal bars
